# Canada’s 2026 time zone updates: guidance for Microsoft SQL

## What Changed

Affected locations in British Columbia, Alberta, and Manitoba will not turn their clocks back at 02:00 local time on November 1, 2026. They will remain at UTC−07:00, UTC−06:00, and UTC−05:00, respectively.
